test_title: PYST 56: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of April 2025, under which pension scheme do the players who won silver or bronze medal in Asian or Commonwealth Games get a pension of ₹12,000 per month?

options.text: Panchayat Yuva Krida aur Khel Abhiyan
Sports Fund for Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports Fund for Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Sports Fund for Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons** is a scheme introduced by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to retired sportspersons for their achievements and contributions.
 
• Sportspersons who have won medals in events like the **Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games** are eligible for pensions under this scheme.
 
• As of April 2025, players who won **silver or bronze medals** in the Asian or Commonwealth Games receive a monthly pension of ₹12,000.
 
• The scheme is designed to ensure financial stability for retired athletes who brought glory to the nation but may lack other sources of income post-retirement.
 
• The pension amount is determined based on the level of achievement, with higher pensions provided to those who have won gold medals or participated in prestigious international tournaments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayat Yuva Krida aur Khel Abhiyan (PYKKA)**

 
 
• Launched in 2008, this scheme aimed to promote rural sports by creating basic sports infrastructure in all villages and blocks of the country.
 
• PYKKA was later replaced by the **Khelo India Programme** in 2016 to broaden the scope of sports promotion in India.
 
• The objective was to encourage youth participation in sports and identify talent at the grassroots level.
